en-US.description: A private, end-to-end encrypted real-time desktop chat application.
en-US.longDescription:
Lunex is a highly secure, real-time desktop chat application built with Tauri, React, and Convex.
It features end-to-end encryption, ensuring that your conversations, messages, and data remain completely private and accessible only to you and your intended recipients.
Designed for speed, privacy, and a seamless user experience.
en-US.name: Lunex
